en.headline: Faster Payment System to suspend service for upgrade on 29 November
en.dek: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said the system will be unavailable from 1 am to 11 am on Sunday while Hong Kong Interbank Clearing carries out maintenance.
body: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said on Monday that the Faster Payment System will suspend service from 1 am to 11 am on 29 November while Hong Kong Interbank Clearing Limited carries out a system upgrade.

The Authority said it had asked banks and stored-value facility operators to notify customers in advance. Members of the public were advised to contact their banks or operators for details of affected services and to make arrangements for payments if needed.
The Faster Payment System, operated by Hong Kong Interbank Clearing, supports real-time transfers using mobile numbers or email addresses.

zh.headline: 轉數快本月29日凌晨1時至早上11時暫停服務
zh.dek: 金管局表示，香港銀行同業結算有限公司將於周日進行系統提升，該時段內轉數快暫停服務。
body: 香港金融管理局周一表示，因應香港銀行同業結算有限公司計劃於11月29日（星期日）凌晨1時至早上11時進行系統提升，轉數快系統將於該時段內暫停服務。
金管局指已要求銀行及儲值支付工具營運商預早通知客戶。市民可聯絡所屬銀行或營運商查詢受影響服務詳情，如有需要可提前安排繳付項目。
轉數快由香港銀行同業結算有限公司營運，支援以手機號碼或電郵地址進行即時跨行轉帳。
